connectorUiConfig.title: Cyolo Activity
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Cyolo Activity data connector allows you to connect to your Cyolo instance and ingest activity logs into Microsoft Sentinel. The connector is built on Microsoft Sentinel's Codeless Connector Platform and uses the Cyolo REST API to fetch user access, authentication, and session events. DCR-based ingestion-time transformations parse the received events into custom columns for better query performance.

sampleQueries.description: Get a sample of Cyolo Activity events

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and write permissions are required to ingest data into the Log Analytics workspace.

customs.name: Cyolo API Key
customs.description: A Cyolo API Key ID and Secret with the Log Admin role are required. See the Cyolo Admin Console documentation to learn more about the Cyolo SIEM API.

instructionSteps.description:
To enable the Cyolo Activity Logs connector, provide the required information below and click Connect.

1. Log in to the Cyolo Admin Console with an Admin user.
2. Go to **Identities** > **API Keys** and create a new key.
3. Under **Roles** > **Admin**, assign the **Log Admin** role to the API key.
4. Enter your base API URL, API Key ID, and API Secret below.
instructionSteps.title: Connect Cyolo Activity Logs to Microsoft Sentinel

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Cyolo solution for Microsoft Sentinel contains two CCF-based data connectors that ingest Cyolo Zero-Trust Access logs into your Microsoft Sentinel workspace: activity logs (user access events, authentication, and sessions) and audit logs (administrative actions, configuration changes, and compliance events). Each connector can be enabled independently.

Data Connectors: 2

Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel | Learn more about Solutions
